text:
deveng: Quick heads-up — targeting tonight's quiet window 23:00 UTC for the cross-service cutover (API + runtime + console + router). Need a short sync and final rollback triggers.

ops-bot: Reservation created for 2024-11-05 23:00 UTC — quiet-window: 60m. Incident channel will be #release-ops if anything goes sideways.

deploy-bot: /schedule deploy --env=prod --window=2024-11-05T23:00Z --services=api,runtime,console,router --canary=5% — queued. Use `/deploy abort <id>` to cancel.

sara: I can do the API pin and release notes. Question: are we pinning runtime -> model-v2 or using runtime fallback rules?

deveng: Good Q. Plan is pin API to model-v2, runtime will accept both model-v1/model-v2 but we set routing weight 90v1/10v2 for initial validation then flip to 100v2 if metrics look good. Console and router need compatible schema v2 headers.

tony: Rollback criteria proposal: if p90 latency increases >150ms over baseline OR error rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> rollback. Also if sampling eval shows regression in generation quality we cut. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on latency/error thresholds. Add token-cost spike detection too — if tokens/sent increases >30% unexpectedly, treat as alert but not auto-rollback.

anna: Release notes checklist: 1) API doc update, 2) Console feature flag added, 3) Ops playbook with rollback steps and `/deploy abort` id. I'll push a draft in the docs repo in 15m.

sara: For the API pin I'm going to run the pin command after canary is up: `./ops/pin-model.sh api model-v2 6149990000` — heads-up to not rerun that until canary green.

deveng: Canary plan: route 5% traffic to new stack for 20 minutes, health checks every 30s. Health check commands: `curl -sS -H 'x-runtime-schema: v2' https://staging.internal/api/health` and look for {"ok":true}.

ops-bot: Canary stage started by deploy-bot (id: 6149990000-1). Traffic 5% -> runtime-canary. Monitoring: APM, latency dashboards, and generation-quality evals.

mike: Running quick eval sets now against canary. Posting results in 10m. If any hallucination spikes we roll back immediately.

tony: Also note console needs the header split change. If console sends legacy header, router should translate. Router team, standby for a tiny header-mapping hotfix if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary finished — metrics: p50 +4ms, p90 +12ms, errors +0.05%. Generation eval delta: negligible. Advise: proceed to 25% ramp.

sara: Pin applied to API. Logs: `PIN_OK model-v2 -> api (ver: 2024-11-05T22:58Z)`

anna: Docs draft link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/6149990000 — added rollback steps and rollback playbook snippet.

mike: Eval run 2 results: no quality regressions in core prompts, small drop on one outlier prompt (investigating).

tony: Proceed to 25% but keep close watch on token-cost and p90. If token-cost spike >20% vs baseline for >10m, hold and triage.

ops-bot: Traffic shifted to 25%. Monitoring alerts enabled: latency, errors, token-cost. Watch channel: #release-ops.

deploy-bot: Rollforward plan ready. To roll back manually: `/deploy abort 6149990000-1` then `/release pin api model-v1`. Auto-rollback not enabled for cost spikes; human in loop.

deveng: Final note — if any team sees a sustained >0.5% error increase or p90 +150ms, call the rollback and we exercise rollback playbook. Otherwise we'll complete full traffic flip after 40m observation.

sara: Thanks all — I'll update the release note with final canary verdict and add change log entry. :thumbsup:

anna: I'll stand by the console flag toggle if needed. Ping me for immediate flip.

mike: No red flags so far, continuing evals.

deveng: Closing this thread when we hit final flip. Good coordination, team. :rocket:
